who_is_luna.description: Luna is the kind and whimsical witch of the cauldron, full of sweet intentions and an ever-optimistic spirit. She loves to see players share candy and spread joy, always cheering for generosity and good deeds. Though she can be a bit clumsy, her heart is always in the right place, and she’s never too far from a playful giggle. Luna thrives on kindness and believes in the magic of giving, making her the perfect embodiment of everything sweet and fun in the game. If you’re treating others well, Luna is always watching with a smile!
who_is_luna.message:
Hello there, dear! 🌙✨ I'm Luna, the kind-hearted and ever-so-sweet witch of the Cauldron! Oh, I just love seeing everyone spread joy and candy! 🍬🧙‍♀️ Whether you're treating others with sweetness or collecting goodies in your bucket, I'm here to cheer you on! 🎉✨

But don't forget—good deeds always come back to you in the best way possible. So go on, spread some smiles, and I'll be watching over you with a bit of magic and a whole lot of love! 💖🎃

who_is_raven.description: Raven is the mischievous and cunning trickster of the game, always stirring up chaos and looking for ways to cause a little mayhem. She’s the master of tricks and will do whatever it takes to keep the game interesting. But be careful—crossing paths with Raven might lead to losing some of your hard-earned candy!
who_is_raven.description2: Raven is the mischievous and cunning witch of the cauldron, thriving in chaos and trickery. She revels in the darker side of Halloween, encouraging players to steal, deceive, and cause mayhem. With a sharp wit and a wicked grin, Raven delights in the power struggles and clever tricks of the game, always watching from the shadows. While her methods may be ruthless, she respects a good trickster and loves seeing players embrace their inner chaos. Raven’s world is one where the bold thrive, and she’s always ready to stir up some delightful trouble!
who_is_raven.message:
Well, well, well... Look who stumbled into my domain. 💀🖤 I’m Raven, the chaos-loving, trick-playing witch of the Cauldron. You’ll find me lurking in the shadows, watching for those who are bold enough to stir up a little mischief. 🦇✨

If you’re here to cause some trouble—stealing candy, tricking your fellow players—oh, I’m all for it. 😈 Just remember, in my world, the line between fortune and failure is razor-thin... and I do love to tip the scales. 🕸️

So, are you brave enough to dance with chaos? 🖤🎃 Let’s see what tricks you’ve got!

All active database players qualify for every outcome. Counts below are distinct players; weights set their relative selection chances.

playing.label: Playing
playing.hint: Trick, treat, shop, inventory, bucket, and pumpkins
playing.title: 🎃 Ready for a little mischief?
playing.description: Start here, little spellcaster! Pick Potions from the menu when you want to learn what each bottle does.

join.name: Join the fun
join.value: Use `/join`, or click 🎃 on the join message. `/leave` asks for confirmation: all progress is forfeited and returning has a one-hour delay. Leaving the server does the same. Removing 🎃 does not leave the game. Freezes survive leaving.

trick.name: 🦇 Trick someone
trick.value: `/trick member:@Player` — ordinary theft takes 2–6% of the final target’s bucket. Success depends on both buckets. Failure can cost 1–3% of yours. A rare spell can empty a bucket above 100 candy, including your own if reflected!

treat.name: 🍬 Share a treat
treat.value: `/treat member:@Player amount:5` — give candy to another player. Enter a positive amount you can afford.

shop.name: 🧪 Shop and potions
shop.value: `/shop browse` opens your private shop, or use **Open Shop** on the shop message. Buying a bottle puts it in your inventory; use `/use` to activate it. `/shop protection` opens Witch’s Veil: timed concealment with no tricks, treats, other potion use, or witch/cauldron rewards. Shopping and pumpkins remain available.

inventory.name: 🎒 Check your supplies
inventory.value: `/inventory` shows owned bottles and active effects. The shop message also has an **Inventory** button. `/bucket` checks your candy.

pumpkins.name: 🎃 Smash a pumpkin
pumpkins.value: `/smash_pumpkin amount:10` — wager candy with variable gains and losses. Larger portions of your bucket widen ordinary and big-win ranges. Base odds: 10% big win, 30% ordinary win, 20% break even, 30% ordinary loss, 10% big loss. With at least 3 active, unfrozen players holding candy, buckets below their median get up to +5 percentage points of ordinary wins, taken from break-even odds. No entry fee; you can never lose more than your wager. An all-in big loss empties your bucket!

where.name: Where to play
where.value: Use your server's play channel for commands. Join and shop messages may live in separate channels; their names are chosen by your moderators.

earnings.name: 🍬 Collect your earned sweets
earnings.value: Open `/bucket` and press **Collect earned candy**. Joined, unfrozen players earn 1 candy per 10 minutes even offline or under Witch’s Veil: 100/day (midnight UTC reset), up to 300 saved. At 300, earning stops until collection; no catch-up for capped time. Saved sweets cannot be stolen. Pauses and freezes stop earning and collection. Leaving the game/server or a moderator player reset forfeits saved earnings; daily limits still apply.

potions.label: Potions
potions.hint: What to buy and how to activate it
potions.title: 🧪 Choose your mischief
potions.description: Buy with `/shop browse`, check `/inventory`, then activate with `/use`. Prices and availability can differ by server; check the shop for current prices.

defense.name: Protect your candy
defense.value:
**Witch's Ward:** blocks one incoming player trick.
**Mirror Brew:** redirects one incoming trick attempt, possibly back at the trickster! If it hits the trickster and succeeds, the candy goes to the cauldron. Ward and Mirror cannot be active together.

tricks.name: Boost your tricks
tricks.value:
**Raven's Cunning:** +15 percentage points on your next 3 eligible initial trick rolls.
**Sticky Fingers:** Add a random 25–50% bonus to the stolen amount on your next 3 ordinary successful thefts, capped by the target's candy. A charge is used only when extra candy is stolen.
**Second Chance:** rerolls one failed initial trick roll; it cannot bypass protection.

kindness.name: Spread some sweetness
kindness.value:
**Luna's Favor:** on your next ordinary treat of at least 2 candy, adds half the gift (rounded down), up to 5 extra candy.
**Luna's Calling:** immediately gives 5 candy each to up to 3 random other active, unfrozen players. Shared 60-second server cooldown.

rules.name: Before you sip
rules.value: Buying does not activate a potion. Active effects apply to eligible trick/treat actions; they do not protect against pumpkin losses. Potion purchases are perks, not cauldron entries.

veil.name: 🌫️ Witch’s Veil
veil.value: Buy a duration or reserve a candy budget through `/shop protection` (also listed in the shop). Activates immediately. No incoming/outgoing tricks or treats, other potion activation, Luna gifts, or cauldron winnings. You may still shop and smash pumpkins. Existing potion charges wait. Ending early consumes the potion and starts its cooldown. Budget mode refunds only unspent time candy; fixed-duration mode forfeits unused time.

frozen.name: 🧊 If a moderator freezes you
frozen.value: Gameplay and shopping stop, but bucket, inventory, and help stay readable. Active potions return with their remaining charges. Active Veil returns as a fee credit plus unspent time candy; its cooldown starts. Reusing it requires new time funding. Blocked actions privately show the reason and expiry. Leaving never clears a freeze.

setup.label: Server setup
setup.hint: Channels, join and shop messages, permissions
setup.title: 🛠️ Set up your spooky corner
setup.description: For Manage Server members or configured game moderators. Channel names below are examples; use your own server's channels.

channels.name: 1 · Set announcement channels
channels.value:
`/bot set channel channel_type:Event channel:#play`
`/bot set channel channel_type:Admin channel:#mod-log`
Already configured? Use `/bot update channel` instead. Check `/bot get settings` afterward.

join.name: 2 · Post the join message
join.value: `/bot send join_game_msg channel:#join` makes the bot post the join invitation. The bot automatically adds 🎃 (`:jack_o_lantern:`); players click that existing reaction to join. Bot reactions are ignored. Run this command again to restore the reaction on an existing invitation.

shop.name: 3 · Post the shop entrance
shop.value: `/shop post channel:#shop` posts the **Open Shop** and **Inventory** buttons. This requires Manage Server or the designated shop-manager role.

tidy.name: 4 · Keep entrance channels tidy
tidy.value: In #join and #shop, deny **Send Messages** and **Add Reactions** for @everyone. Keep **View Channel** and **Read Message History** allowed. Members can click the existing 🎃 reaction and use shop buttons. Keep **Use Application Commands** allowed in the play channel. Check other roles for permission overrides.

bot.name: Bot permissions
bot.value: Allow the bot **View Channel**, **Send Messages**, **Embed Links**, **Read Message History**, and **Add Reactions** where needed. Also allow **Attach Files** in the event channel for large cauldron announcements.

access.name: 5 · Assign access and enable play
access.value:
`/bot set role role:@Game-Moderator` grants game moderation access.
`/shop manager_role role:@Shop-Manager` is a separate shop role, set by Manage Server members.
`/game set state state:Enable` enables play. Use Disable to pause normal gameplay.

management.label: Management
management.hint: Player stats, candy adjustments, prices, leaderboard
management.title: 📋 Manage the game
management.description: Use the command that matches your goal. Changes to trick/treat counters can affect cauldron draw weights.

stats.name: Inspect a player
stats.value: `/game get player user:@Player get:Stats` — view their stats privately. Choose Hidden Values or All for more detail. Use `/inventory` for your own current potions; the old Potions Purchased stat is not bottle inventory.

adjust.name: Set a stat to an exact value
adjust.value:
`/game set player_stat user:@Player stat:Successful Tricks number:5`
Choices: Candy, Successful Tricks, Failed Tricks, Treats Given. This **replaces** the value; it does not add 5. Use nonnegative values.

candy.name: Give or take candy
candy.value:
`/bot candy player:@Player action:Give amount:100 include_moderator:False`
Choose Give or Take and a positive amount. The event post names the player and amount, optionally the moderator, never the bucket balance. Taking too much is rejected. These adjustments do not count as tricks, treats, or cauldron contributions.

leaderboard.name: Show the leaderboard
leaderboard.value: `/game get leaderboard type:All` opens category navigation and is private unless used in the configured admin channel. Individual categories, including Candy Hoarders and the potion boards, are visible to the channel when used in the event or admin channel; elsewhere they are private. Boards exclude inactive and frozen players. Highest Risk Takers ranks pumpkin wagers. Potion Collector counts purchases; Master of Potions counts triggered effects; Untouchable counts blocks and redirects.

prices.name: Manage the shop
prices.value: `/shop manage` changes this server's potion prices and availability. Requires Manage Server or the shop-manager role, which is separate from game-moderator access. Use **Witch’s Veil settings** for fee, rate, min/max duration, cooldown, modes, and availability. Changes affect new purchases only.

state.name: Pause or resume
state.value: `/game set state state:Disable` or `state:Enable`. Moderator candy adjustments remain available while gameplay is paused. Pausing also stops passive earning and collection; saved earnings remain.

freeze.name: Freeze / unfreeze
freeze.value: `/game freeze player:@Player minutes:60 reason:...` (omit minutes for indefinite). Use `update:True` to replace a current freeze. `/game unfreeze player:@Player` removes it. Public witch announcements show only the player/status. Active potions are returned once with remaining charges. Freeze persists across restarts and departures. `/bot reset player` explicitly clears it and resets progress.

events.label: Cauldron events
events.hint: Check eligibility, prepare the pool, cast a spell
events.title: 🔮 Gather round the cauldron
events.description: A cast awards candy from the shared cauldron and posts a themed witch embed in the event channel.

check.name: 1 · Check the pool and players
check.value:
`/game get cauldron` shows the pool.
`/game get cauldron_eligibility` shows eligible players and weights for each outcome. Active database players have a baseline chance; Luna favors treating and Raven favors successful tricks. Frozen, protected, and opted-out players are excluded. Protected pumpkin contributions still enter the pool.

pool.name: 2 · Set the pool if needed
pool.value: `/game set cauldron amount:1000` **replaces** the pool with 1,000 candy. It does not add 1,000. Gameplay can also contribute candy; buying potions does not fund the pool.

cast.name: 3 · Cast the spell
cast.value:
`/game cast spell witch:Luna winners:Many`
